label: Bus Chat: Host
description: Demo node. Creates a Bus, registers as 'host', waits for a 'guest' to connect, then chats a few lines (host opens the conversation) and closes the bus. Pair with a Bus Chat: Guest node.

inputs.name: pauseSeconds
inputs.label: Pause seconds
inputs.description: Seconds the host waits on a timer after the first exchange, its bus open, before it goes on. 0 does not wait.
